mm7/hnp1el.name: hnp1el
mm7/hnp1el.material: rough pale cream-white plaster wall with faint grey mottling, under a band of dark rough rubble stone along the top, with a column of dark rough rubble stone along the left edge; one even plaster tone with no square patches

notes.2: the plaster beside the rubble column is the same pale cream plaster as the sharp areas, with the reference's soft shadow gradient darkening only towards the column; continue the sharp plaster seamlessly, with no visible boundary, band or rectangle
notes.3: one continuous pale cream plaster surface with the reference's soft shadow darkening only right next to the rubble column, no bands, rectangles or vertical boundaries in the plaster; the right edge continues the sharp neighbouring plaster
notes.4: one continuous pale cream plaster surface with the reference's soft shadow darkening only right next to the rubble column, no bands, rectangles or vertical boundaries in the plaster; the right edge continues the sharp neighbouring plaster
